summary: Studio Art Engine: an NFT collection generator focused on layer-based creation, rarity/rules, preview, and export; expanding Ethereum (ERC-721) workflows with a critical Pinata-based IPFS deployment pipeline (folder CID uploads for images + metadata) and a project immutability/provenance lock.
architectural_notes: Blockchain selector should include Ethereum/Polygon/Base/BNB (export-only) and default new projects to Ethereum (ERC-721).
Users can change the target chain later during metadata generation/export (default is not locked-in).
Cardano (CIP-25) and Tezos (FA2) options/support should be removed.
Add a Project Settings panel 'Lock Project' toggle; when locked, disable Generate and treat the project as immutable for provenance.
Pinata IPFS deployment flow: upload images folder -> IMAGES_FOLDER_CID; ERC-721 metadata image field must be ipfs://IMAGES_FOLDER_CID/<TOKEN_ID>.png; upload metadata folder -> METADATA_FOLDER_CID.
Pinata credentials: users provide their own Pinata API key/secret (store as user-supplied settings/credentials).
Export requirement: images must be sequentially named (1.png, 2.png, …) and strictly match configured pixel dimensions.

existing_features.title: Retry the full application build and ensure the project compiles successfully after changes, with no TypeScript build errors and no runtime crashes on initial load.

Review the entire codebase and remove unused and redundant files and unnecessary code paths that are not used by the app, while preserving all current app behavior (project creation, layer/trait workshop, rules, preview, vault generation/export, settings, Pinata/IPFS publishing, and localStorage persistence).

Perform a targeted cleanup of clearly unused placeholders and legacy scaffolding related to persistence/querying and backend storage, including removing files that are intentionally empty or unused, and trimming backend code that is not referenced by the frontend (while keeping the single-actor backend architecture intact).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add full export-only metadata support for Polygon (ERC-721), Base (ERC-721), and BNB Chain (BEP-721)
Change default new collection chain/metadata format from Solana (Metaplex) to Ethereum (ERC-721); allow users to switch chain later during metadata generation
Remove Cardano (CIP-25) and Tezos (FA2) chain options/support from export selector
Planned: Full ICP-native storage of NFTs (images + metadata + assets stored in canister storage)
Planned: Project-level cloud sync so artwork/collections persist across sessions
Planned: Advanced rarity analytics and collection-grade statistical reports

Add critical Pinata-based IPFS deployment workflow: Project Settings 'Lock Project' toggle (disables Generate & makes project immutable), export images as 1.png/2.png… matching configured dimensions, upload image folder to Pinata for IMAGES_FOLDER_CID, generate 1.json/2.json… ERC-721 metadata with image=ipfs://IMAGES_FOLDER_CID/<TOKEN_ID>.png, then upload metadata folder to Pinata for METADATA_FOLDER_CID; users provide Pinata API key/secret
